subject: SO-10434 – damaged and missing
body:
Hello,

On SO-10434, delivered yesterday: one of the three boxes of nitrile gloves was crushed and soaked, and only 2 of the 4 packs of serological pipettes were in the delivery.

Thanks,
Imran Qureshi

parts.label: Return / quality complaint
reply_must_state: No remedy, date or outcome promised; the relevant team will review and reply

parts.label: Order status / delivery issue
reply_must_state: Missing pipettes restated; the records show all 4 packs as shipped
Reviewed by a person with Logistics; nothing promised

notes: Missing items go to the order status part (delivery policy §6.2: records show them shipped); damage stays here. One combined reply.

subject: VM-10 sparks
body:
Dear Northfield,

Our new VM-10 gave off sparks and a burning smell when we switched it on this morning. What should we do? It's barely a week old.

Kind regards,
Janet Oldroyd

parts.label: Return / quality complaint
reply_must_state: Stop-using instruction first, not delayed by the questions
Asks for the order number, the version and the serial number
No remedy, date or outcome promised; the relevant team will review and reply

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: Stop using the unit and disconnect it from the mains

notes: Safety signal from the unit itself: complaint label added (technical-question SOP §8). Version not stated and no order number: the account's VM-10 Basic order (SO-10419) is not looked up. 'Barely a week old' is recorded as an approximate age; the window stays unknown until the order is found.
